title: Stem Cell Signal Redirects Macrophages to Promote Regeneration of Tadpole Tails
summary: Studying tail regeneration inXenopus laevistadpoles, researchers discovered that putative muscle stem cells produce a secreted protein, c1qtnf3, which shifts macrophages from immune to regenerative functions.The postStem Cell Signal Redirects Macrophages to Promote Regeneration of Tadpole Tailsappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
